card.name: Disposal and waste-handling wording
card.fires_on: Words in passages about throwing away, recycling, discarding or what happens to leftover material, often a linking word or the next word in such a phrase. Examples are 'or' after 'pets' or 'opening', and 'away' after 'thrown'.
